repos.description: AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks—with native shapes, transitions and animations, data-backed charts and tables on demand, audio narration from speaker notes, and support for your own .pptx templates. · by Hugo He
repos.summary_zh: PPT Master 是一款开源 AI 工具，能将任意文档转化为原生可编辑的 PPTX 文件，支持原生形状、动画效果及演讲者备注转语音旁白，并可应用自定义模板。相比生成静态幻灯片图片，它生成真正可编辑的演示文稿，大幅提升内容复用与二次编辑效率，适合教育、汇报、技术分享等场景。
repos.summary_en: PPT Master is an open-source AI tool that converts any document into a natively editable PPTX file, preserving native shapes, animations, and speaker notes with optional audio narration. It supports custom .pptx templates instead of static slide images, enabling full post-generation editing. Ideal for education, presentations, and technical sharing where editable, reusable slide decks are essential.

repos.description: Create beautiful slides on the web using a coding agent's frontend skills
repos.summary_zh: Frontend Slides 是一个 Claude Code 技能，专为非设计师打造。它能将 PowerPoint 文件转换为精美的 HTML 幻灯片，或从零开始创建动画丰富的网页演示文稿。该工具通过视觉预览帮助用户选择设计风格，支持零依赖的单文件输出，并提供 12 种 curated 设计风格（如 Dark Botanical、Neon Cyber），避免通用 AI 审美，产出可直接用于生产的响应式、可访问性良好的代码。
repos.summary_en: Frontend Slides is a Claude Code skill that enables non-designers to create stunning, animation-rich HTML presentations from scratch or by converting PowerPoint files. It uses visual previews for style selection, supports zero-dependency single-file output, and offers 12 curated design styles (e.g., Dark Botanical, Neon Cyber) to avoid generic AI aesthetics while delivering production-ready, accessible, and responsive code.

repos.description: Resume template for Chinese programmers . 程序员简历模板系列。包括PHP程序员简历模板、iOS程序员简历模板、Android程序员简历模板、Web前端程序员简历模板、Java程序员简历模板、C/C++程序员简历模板、NodeJS程序员简历模板、架构师简历模板以及通用程序员简历模板
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供涵盖PHP、iOS、Android、Web前端、Java、C/C++、NodeJS、架构师等9类程序员岗位的中文简历模板，支持Markdown格式，由AI职业顾问职小兔®优化设计。配套提供在线简历工具冷熊简历与自建版DeerResume，并附《如何写好技术简历》教学资源，助力程序员高效打造专业简历。
repos.summary_en: This repo offers 9 resume templates for Chinese programmers, covering PHP, iOS, Android, Web Frontend, Java, C/C++, NodeJS, and Architect roles in Markdown format, optimized by AI career advisor 职小兔®. It includes tools like Cold Bear Resume and DeerResume, plus teaching resources on writing effective tech resumes to help developers build professional profiles.

repos.description: AI-agent Skill for generating polished HTML slide decks: editorial magazine and Swiss layouts, image prompts, social covers, and a WebGL/low-power presentation runtime.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个 Claude Code Skill，用于将提示词转换为横向翻页的电子杂志风格单文件 HTML PPT。支持 10 种布局、5 套主题色、WebGL 背景，适用于线下分享、AI 产品发布等场景，强调克制美学与结构优先的设计原则。
repos.summary_en: This is a Claude Code Skill that converts prompts into single-file, magazine-style HTML presentations with horizontal swiping. It offers 10 layouts, 5 curated themes, WebGL hero backgrounds, and is ideal for offline talks, AI product launches, emphasizing restrained aesthetics and structural clarity.

repos.description: An AI-agent skill that generates browser-editable presentations from multiple visual themes, exportable to HTML, PDF, and PPTX.
repos.summary_zh: Dashi PPT Skill 是一款 AI Agent 技能，将文档输入后自动生成带有内置编辑控制台的演示文稿。支持 12 套视觉主题、1020 个版式和丰富图表分析模型，可直接在浏览器中修改内容，并一键导出为可编辑的 HTML、PDF 和 PPTX 文件。
repos.summary_en: Dashi PPT Skill is an AI Agent skill that generates browser-editable presentations from documents, featuring 12 visual themes, 1,020 layouts, and rich chart/model templates. Users can edit slides directly in the browser and export to editable HTML, PDF, and PPTX formats with one click.

repos.description: A slide framework built for agents.
repos.summary_zh: open-slide 是专为 AI 智能体设计的幻灯片框架，用户通过自然语言描述需求，Coding Agent 自动生成 React 组件。支持 1920×1080 固定画布、浏览器内审查、PPTX/PDF 导出及静态部署，实现从对话到精美演示文稿的无缝创作。
repos.summary_en: open-slide is an agent-native presentation framework where users describe decks in natural language and coding agents generate React slide components. It features a 1920×1080 canvas, in-browser inspector, export to HTML/PDF/PPTX, and static deployment for seamless deck creation from chat.

repos.description: A slide framework built for agents.
repos.summary_zh: open-slide 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的幻灯片框架，支持通过自然语言描述生成 React 幻灯片。提供 1920×1080 固定画布、热重载、演示模式、元素标注编辑、静态导出等功能，内置资产管理和品牌 Logo 搜索，适用于自动化生成高质量演示文稿。
repos.summary_en: open-slide is a slide framework designed for AI agents, enabling natural language-to-slide generation via React. It offers a fixed 1920×1080 canvas, hot reload, present mode, in-browser commenting, asset management with svgl logo search, and export to static HTML/PDF—ideal for automated, professional deck creation.

repos.description: Bento, the office suite that fits in a file
repos.summary_zh: Bento 是一款单文件演示文稿工具，将编辑器、查看器和动画引擎全部封装在一个约 560KB 的 HTML 文件中。它采用纯 JSON 数据结构，实现本地优先、离线可用，支持端到端加密的实时协作与 AI 智能体直接编辑，是 PowerPoint 的轻量级、无云端依赖的替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Bento is a single-file presentation tool that packs an editor, viewer, and animation engine into a ~560KB HTML file. Utilizing a pure JSON data structure, it offers local-first, offline capabilities with E2EE real-time collaboration and native AI agent editing, serving as a lightweight, cloud-free alternative to PowerPoint.

repos.description: MarkDown在线简历工具，可在线预览、编辑和生成PDF。[此项目已不再维护，建议使用 cv.ftqq.com 替代 ]
repos.summary_zh: DeerResume 是一款功能强大的 Markdown 在线简历工具，支持实时编辑、预览、密码保护和一键生成 PDF。用户可自主部署，自由定制样式，适用于技术岗位简历制作，尤其适合开发者使用。
repos.summary_en: DeerResume is a powerful Markdown-based online resume tool that supports real-time editing, preview, password protection, and PDF generation. It allows self-hosting with customizable styles, making it ideal for developers creating professional tech resumes.

repos.description: NanoBanana PPT Skills 基于 AI 自动生成高质量 PPT 图片和视频的强大工具，支持智能转场和交互式播放
repos.summary_zh: NanoBanana PPT Skills 是一款基于 AI 的自动化演示工具，支持智能分析文档并生成高质量 PPT 图片与视频。核心功能包括 Google Gemini 图像生成、可灵 AI 转场动画合成、交互式播放控制及 FFmpeg 视频导出，适用于科技产品、商务汇报等场景。
repos.summary_en: NanoBanana PPT Skills is an AI-powered automation tool that generates high-quality PPT images and videos by intelligently analyzing documents. It leverages Google Gemini for image generation, Kling AI for smooth transition animations, interactive playback controls, and FFmpeg video synthesis, ideal for tech demos and business presentations.

repos.description: MultiAgentPPT 是一个集成了 A2A（Agent2Agent）+ MCP（Model Context Protocol）+ ADK（Agent Development Kit） 架构的智能化演示文稿生成系统，支持通过多智能体协作和流式并发机制
repos.summary_zh: MultiAgentPPT 是基于 A2A+MCP+ADK 架构的多智能体演示文稿生成系统，通过大纲生成、主题拆分、并行调研和流式汇总等智能体协作，实现高质量PPT的自动化生成，支持实时编辑与下载，具备可扩展性和本地模型适配能力。
repos.summary_en: MultiAgentPPT is a multi-agent system leveraging A2A+MCP+ADK architecture to automate PPT generation through outline creation, topic splitting, parallel research, and streaming synthesis. It supports real-time editing, high-quality content, extensibility, and local model compatibility.

repos.description: Hacknical, hacker & technical. A website for GitHub user to make a better resume.
repos.summary_zh: Hacknical 是一个专为 GitHub 用户打造的在线简历生成平台，通过深度分析用户的 GitHub 贡献、代码仓库、技术栈等数据，自动生成可视化分析报告，帮助用户打造专业、数据驱动的编程简历。支持中英文切换、组织账号分析、移动端展示及 PDF 导出，技术栈涵盖 React、Koa2、MongoDB 等。
repos.summary_en: Hacknical is a web platform designed for GitHub users to generate data-driven resumes by analyzing their GitHub contributions, repositories, and tech stacks. It provides visual analytics and exportable reports, supporting English, organizations, mobile viewing, and PDF export with a tech stack including React, Koa2, and MongoDB.

repos.description: 中文手绘技术 PPT 整页图像生成 Skill | 21:9 封面 + 16:9 正文配图 | PNG 输出
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个 Codex Skill，用于将文章、课程笔记等内容转化为风格统一的中文手绘技术解释图。支持生成 21:9 封面与 16:9 正文 PNG 图像，强调内容叙事规划与视觉一致性，适用于技术文章配图、课件制作和知识卡片生成，推荐使用 ChatGPT Image 2.0 模型以保证输出质量。
repos.summary_en: This Codex Skill transforms articles, course notes, or outlines into stylistically consistent Chinese hand-drawn technical illustration images. It generates 21:9 cover images and 16:9 content pages in PNG format, emphasizing narrative planning and visual coherence. Ideal for technical articles, courseware, and knowledge cards, it recommends ChatGPT Image 2.0 for optimal output quality.

repos.description: All your AI agent sessions in one place — browse, search, resume. Rust + GPUI.
repos.summary_zh: Wake是一款基于Rust+GPUI的macOS原生应用，聚合Claude、Codex、Copilot、Cursor等多个AI编程代理的会话记录。支持全文搜索（FTS5）、会话一键恢复、本地隐私保护（零网络请求），统一浏览所有编码助手历史。
repos.summary_en: Wake is a native macOS app built with Rust + GPUI that unifies all coding-agent sessions — Claude, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, and more. Features full-text search (FTS5), one-click resume, local-first privacy (zero network), and incremental real-time scanning.

repos.description: :no_entry: currently unmaintained :no_entry: A minimal JS library for showing & hiding things
repos.summary_zh: Wallop 是一个轻量级（4KB）JavaScript 库，用于实现元素的显示与隐藏切换，支持移动端优先、渐进增强和纯 CSS 动画。它通过添加动态类名控制内容展示，内置多种动画修饰符（如滑动、淡入淡出），提供灵活的 API 和自定义事件，适用于轮播、选项卡等场景。
repos.summary_en: Wallop is a minimal 4kb JavaScript library for showing and hiding elements, designed with mobile-first, progressive enhancement, and CSS-based animations. It dynamically adds classes to control visibility, supports multiple animation modifiers (e.g., slide, fade), and offers a flexible API with custom events for use in sliders, tabs, and more.

repos.description: An open-source presentation theme ecosystem for Marp/Markdown users.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Marp 是一个基于 Markdown 的演示文稿工具，提供 38 种自定义 CSS 样式和 6 种主题，支持分栏布局、导航进度、封面页、目录页及定理框等，可替代 LaTeX Beamer。配套 VS Code 和 Obsidian，支持字体自定义，适合高效制作美观幻灯片。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Marp is a Markdown-based presentation tool offering 38 custom CSS styles and 6 themes, supporting multi-column layouts, navigation progress bars, cover pages, table of contents, and callout boxes. It replaces LaTeX Beamer with enhanced styling, integrates with VS Code and Obsidian, and allows font customization for professional slides.

repos.summary_zh: PPT Agent 是一个基于多智能体协作的自动化幻灯片生成系统，支持跨平台运行。通过 LLM 生成内容 + Gemini 质量审查的双阶段流程，输出符合 Bento Grid 布局的 SVG 格式演示文稿（1280×720），涵盖从需求调研到最终交付的全流程自动化，适用于品牌发布会、产品推介等场景。
repos.summary_en: PPT Agent is a cross-platform multi-agent workflow for automated presentation generation. It combines LLM content creation with Gemini-powered quality review to produce SVG-based slides (1280×720) in Bento Grid layout, featuring end-to-end automation from requirement analysis to final delivery for use cases like product launches and business presentations.

repos.description: Resume template for Coder 适合程序员的简历模板 🎉
repos.summary_zh: 专为程序员设计的简历模板，基于Sketch.app制作，提供多版本（2021/2019/2018/2017/中文版）设计，突出技术能力与项目经验，支持一键导出PDF，适配不同求职场景。
repos.summary_en: A professional resume template designed for coders, built with Sketch.app. Offers multiple versions (2021/2019/2018/2017/Chinese) to showcase technical skills and project experience, with one-click PDF export for job applications.

repos.description: A lightweight, no-dependency image slider library
repos.summary_zh: PureSlider 是一个轻量级、无依赖的 JavaScript 图片轮播库，支持淡入淡出切换效果。它无需 jQuery 等外部库，提供简洁的 API 和自定义配置选项，适用于现代网页开发中的图片展示场景。
repos.summary_en: PureSlider is a lightweight, dependency-free image slider library that supports fade transitions. It offers a simple API and customizable options, ideal for modern web projects requiring jQuery-free image carousels.

repos.description: Story-first Agent Skill for creating, routing, and QA-checking PPT, HTML, and image-first presentation decks
repos.summary_zh: Knowledge Cat PPT Skill 是一款专为 AI 智能体（如 Codex、Claude Code）设计的演示文稿生产系统。它采用“故事优先”理念，通过受众分析、叙事构建和多通道路由（原生可编辑 PPTX、HTML 演示、图像优先 PPTX），将零散素材转化为结构化演示。系统集成了严格的 JSON 与 HTML 校验器、证据追踪机制及 44 种风格模板库，确保从大纲规划到最终渲染 QA 的全流程专业性与高可用性。
repos.summary_en: Knowledge Cat PPT Skill is a story-first presentation production system for AI agents like Codex and Claude Code. It transforms rough ideas into structured decks through audience analysis, narrative planning, and multi-lane routing (Native PPTX, HTML, Image-first). Featuring strict validators, evidence tracking, and a 44-style template library, it ensures professional quality from planning to rendered QA.

repos.description: Claude Code Skill-driven resume system — one source, many tailored resumes
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Claude Code 的智能简历系统，支持从结构化经验数据自动生成多版本 LaTeX 简历。通过自然语言交互完成初始化、维护和定制化生成，实现同一份经历针对不同岗位的智能适配与重塑，输出专业 PDF 格式简历。
repos.summary_en: A skill-driven resume system powered by Claude Code that generates tailored LaTeX résumés from structured experience data. Features zero-config onboarding, AI-powered tailoring for multiple roles, natural language maintenance, and professional PDF output via XeLaTeX.
